snippet.title: The Last Driver — Coming Soon to the App Store
snippet.description: In a world ravaged by Nuclear Annihilation, Zombie Apocalypse and Alien Invasion there's only one way to drive: FAST and DANGEROUSLY! As The Last Driver you must career through a ravaged cityscape blasting zombies out of the way with an arsenal of car mounted cannons. This IS NOT 'Drivers Ed' this is SURVIVAL!
